summary: No new arrests or incidents had been posted for Nov. 14 to the Alaska State Troopers daily dispatch or the Fairbanks Police daily bulletin at the time of this reading, and neither feed had added anything to the four days before it. No new criminal case had been opened at any of the four Fairbanks-area courts since Friday afternoon. The Alaska Court System's weekly report of criminal cases filed ran on the night of Nov. 13 and lists 46 cases filed inside the area in the week to Nov. 13; its counts below are the report's own counts for that window. Both daily feeds routinely add entries to past dates, so the figures here are the figures as of this reading rather than totals for the day.

entries.title: Court report: 46 criminal cases filed in Fairbanks-area courts in the week to Nov. 13
body: The Alaska Court System's weekly report of criminal cases filed ran on the night of Nov. 13 and covers the week of Nov. 7 to Nov. 13. Inside the Fairbanks area it lists 46 cases: 41 at the Fairbanks court, four at Delta Junction, one at Nenana and none at Healy.
The report lists charges as filed. A person named in it has not been convicted, and charges can be amended or dismissed as a case goes on.

The newest nine cases in the report are the eight opened on Nov. 13 and already reported here - two theft arrests on the Johansen Expressway, three drunk-driving arrests from Nov. 12, two Fairbanks assault charges and a criminal mischief charge at Delta Junction - together with a Nenana traffic case filed Nov. 9 on one count of driving in violation of an instruction permit, with the offense recorded at Nenana on Oct. 27.

On the Fairbanks assault case opened Nov. 13 against Catherine Mutchler, the weekly report records both counts with no domestic violence flag, which matches the court's own case file. The trooper release announcing the arrest described the charge as assault in the fourth degree, domestic violence. Both records are reported here as each states it.
